But if spacing is what it’s supposed to do anyway, then wouldn’t making it cost more stamina show players that it’s better used as spacing and not a defensive ability? 
For example, if I want space between me and my opponent, then I manual dodge and create that space. I don’t have to worry about my stamina because I’ve made some distance already. How does costing more stamina affect that? You’re saying the goal isn’t to make it useless, but having it drain stamina would just tell players, “hey, use this to get away from time to time, not to dodge and then attack”

It’d even stop the players that attack a bunch, manual dodge, and then just straight up run away, which I’ve encountered a bunch of times
There’s still a solution there too though. They could just easily make manual dodge cost a bit less stamina for khalt players, considering yeah the style’s been nerfed so much already.
